facts_raw.Program: Techstars Future of Food powered by Ecolab
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: At acceptance / after standard legal checks; typically wired within ~3 weeks
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K Post-Money CEA for 5% common; side letter includes pro-rata and other rights
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No; company must be incorporated in a Techstars-acceptable US/foreign equivalent structure before investment closes
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队 Accepted founders are expected to dedicate full exclusivity to the startup during the accelerator. Techstars invests only after incorporation/ownership/IP/bank-account checks.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid；存在必须/高价值线下节点，主要地点：US。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Final deadline Jun 10, 2026; Demo Day Dec 10, 2026
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；Climate / Energy；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品

facts.Program: Techstars Future of Food powered by Ecolab

facts.Equity / Economic Terms: $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K Post-Money CEA for 5% common; side letter includes pro-rata and other rights
facts.Company Required at Application: No; company must be incorporated in a Techstars-acceptable US/foreign equivalent structure before investment closes
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders Accepted founders are expected to dedicate full exclusivity to the startup during the accelerator. Techstars invests only after incorporation/ownership/IP/bank-account checks.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid, with required or high-value in-person sessions. Main location: US.
facts.International Founder: International founders may be eligible; confirm visa and attendance requirements.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.

facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Early stage stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
